name: Tisagenlecleucel
summary: An autologous CAR-T cell therapy. The patient's own T cells are engineered with a lentiviral vector to carry a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) against CD19, then given back to find and kill CD19-positive B cells.

target.name: CD19 on B cells
target.cell: CAR-T cell meeting a malignant B cell

journey.title: T cells are collected
journey.text: White blood cells are collected from the patient's own blood by leukapheresis.

journey.title: Engineered outside the body
journey.text: At the manufacturing site, the T cells are transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding the anti-CD19 CAR, expanded, then formulated and cryopreserved as the drug product.

journey.title: Infused back
journey.text: The patient's own modified T cells are returned by intravenous infusion.

journey.title: Expands inside the patient
journey.text: On meeting CD19, the CAR-T cells multiply. Unlike a conventional drug, the product keeps growing after it is given.

journey.title: Finds CD19-positive cells
journey.text: CD19 is present on normal and malignant B cells in the blood, bone marrow and lymphoid tissue.

journey.title: Persists and patrols
journey.text: CAR-T cells can persist for months, so normal B cells can stay depleted (B-cell aplasia) for a long time.

mechanism.title: The CAR finds CD19
mechanism.text: The CAR's murine anti-CD19 single-chain variable fragment (scFv) binds CD19 on the B cell.

mechanism.title: The T cell switches on
mechanism.text: Binding signals through the CAR's 4-1BB (CD137) and CD3ζ domains and activates the T cell without needing antigen presented on MHC.

mechanism.title: It kills the target cell
mechanism.text: The activated CAR-T cell releases cytotoxic granules and cytokines that kill the CD19-positive cell.

mechanism.title: It multiplies and persists
mechanism.text: Activation drives expansion and persistence. The cytokine surge from mass activation is the source of cytokine release syndrome.

facts.label: Product
facts.value: Autologous T cells modified with a lentiviral vector

facts.label: CAR design
facts.value: Murine anti-CD19 scFv · CD8α hinge and transmembrane · 4-1BB · CD3ζ

simplified: Manufacturing is shown as a single ex-vivo step. The real process includes T-cell activation, transduction, expansion, formulation, release testing and cryopreservation.
Killing is drawn as granule release; cytokine-mediated and other killing routes are not shown separately.
The body map is a schematic; organ shapes and positions are approximate.

sources.text: KYMRIAH (tisagenlecleucel) suspension for intravenous infusion, US Prescribing Information, Novartis. Boxed warning, sections 11 Description and 12.1 Mechanism of Action.
